newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman ups TI EPS outlook.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman ups TI EPS outlook.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Rajiv Chaudhri said he raised his earnings estimates on Texas Instruments Inc for the 1997 and 1998 years and maintained the stock on Goldman's recommended list.
-- The analyst said he raised his 1997 earnings outlook to to $3.60 per share from $3.25 per share previously.

-- He said that for 1998 he expected Texas Instruments to earn $5.75 per share, up from the $5.25 he set two weeks ago. Prior to that, Chaudhri said he had expected the company to earn $4.75 per share in 1998.

-- Chaudhri said growing optimism about Texas Instruments' earnings potential reflects the "very aggressive goals" the company is is setting for itself to increase its operating profit margins in relation to the industry.
-- Noting how in the past the company has lagged rivals by a significant margin in terms of its operating margin goals Chaudhri said, "What they are saying is, 'No more.'"

-- He said he believes the company will see operating profit margins of 10 percent in 1997 and 13 percent in 1998. He noted that the company's operating margins for 1996 are not really comparable because of a series of restructuring charges and discontinued operations.
-- For comparison, he pointed to the 12 percent operating margin in 1995, a strong growth year for the industry.
-- The stock closed at 83-7/8 on Friday.
